entries.affirmation: I step forward before I know the way.
entries.narrative: Nikolai works beneath the Closed City, repairing machines whose true purpose no one will explain. When containment doors seal with workers still trapped below, he opens a forbidden service route, saving them while giving the breach another path into the city.
entries.flavor_text: Machines tell the truth before men do.

relationships.subject: Nikolai's younger sister
relationships.dynamic: His desire to get her transferred out of the Closed City makes every act of obedience feel like protection and every act of rebellion feel dangerously personal.

relationships.subject: The trapped reactor workers
relationships.dynamic: Nikolai chooses solidarity with ordinary workers over the containment orders protecting scientists, officers, and the state project.

hidden_threads.clue: Nikolai remembers opening the forbidden route, but later evidence leaves open whether he acted alone or followed an invitation already waiting beyond the sealed door.

entries.interpretation: Nikolai is not a celebrated scientist, officer, or chosen mystic. He becomes the Fool because he is the first ordinary person to step beyond the sanctioned map. His choice begins in compassion, but he cannot know whether the open passage leads toward freedom or a greater catastrophe.
entries.when_drawn: Take the first necessary step, even if the entire road is not visible. Trust your purpose, but remain honest about the consequences you cannot yet see.

entries.affirmation: I turn knowledge into deliberate action.
entries.narrative: Mikhail combines reactor data, orbital signals, and Elena's dream research to explain the impossible. Their unresolved intimacy is strained by rivalry and betrayal, yet he still trusts her mind more than anyone else's. When the systems synchronize, he collapses and becomes the unconscious center of the convergence.
entries.flavor_text: The data is made of symbols.

relationships.subject: Dr. Elena Morozova
relationships.dynamic: Their intellectual partnership carries unresolved tenderness, rivalry, and betrayal; Mikhail trusts Elena's mind even when he doubts her conclusions.

hidden_threads.clue: While unconscious, Mikhail may be shaping the worlds he believes he is only witnessing.

entries.interpretation: Mikhail embodies the Magician's ability to transform knowledge into power. His danger is believing that producing a result gives him the right to control it. While unconscious, he may also be shaping the worlds he believes he is only witnessing.
entries.when_drawn: Use the tools already within reach, but do not let mastery become an excuse to ignore the human cost.

entries.affirmation: I trust what speaks beneath the surface.
entries.narrative: Elena discovers that separate test subjects are dreaming the same symbols and secretly routes their data into the signal archive. Mikhail challenges her conclusions, while Major Yuri Volkov hides a love for her that will eventually matter more to him than his orders. After Elena disappears, Yuri hears her voice inside the breach and cannot accept that it may no longer belong entirely to her.
entries.flavor_text: Dreams are not private in a wounded world.

relationships.subject: Dr. Mikhail Orlov
relationships.dynamic: Their intimate intellectual history is marked by tenderness, rivalry, and betrayal.

relationships.subject: Major Yuri Volkov
relationships.dynamic: Yuri's concealed love for Elena will eventually outweigh his containment orders.

hidden_threads.clue: After Elena disappears, her voice continues in the signal, but it may no longer belong entirely to her.

entries.interpretation: Elena guards the threshold between measurable science and hidden knowledge. Her secrecy draws Mikhail, Yuri, and the convergence toward her for different reasons, but even she may not know which presence answered first.
entries.when_drawn: Listen before acting, especially when loyalty and desire make the truth difficult to hear. What remains hidden may be protecting you, controlling you, or waiting for you to recognize it.

entries.affirmation: I decide what deserves to grow.
entries.narrative: Irina Karpova built her fortune by recognizing dangerous ideas before anyone else understood their value. She shields Elena's research from officials who would bury it, then surrounds it with locks, favors, and people loyal only to her. Colonel Semyonov commands the Closed City, but Irina has invested in whatever comes after it.
entries.flavor_text: Power is wasted on those who only know how to spend it.

relationships.subject: Dr. Elena Morozova
relationships.dynamic: Irina's protection may conceal ambition, affection, or a desire to possess the one doorway she cannot purchase.

relationships.subject: Colonel Viktor Semyonov
relationships.dynamic: Semyonov commands the facility, while Irina controls much of what it is allowed to become.

entries.interpretation: Irina can offer protection, luxury, and the freedom to create, but nothing in her world is truly given away. Her fascination with Elena may be ambition, affection, or the desire to possess the one doorway she cannot purchase.
entries.when_drawn: Nurture what holds genuine promise, but read the terms before accepting shelter. The hand feeding your dream may already consider it theirs.

entries.affirmation: I create order without becoming its prisoner.
entries.narrative: Colonel Semyonov has spent his career containing threats the public must never learn exist. He considers Elena both a vital asset and a spreading contamination, while Major Yuri Volkov's attachment to her makes him dangerously unreliable. When the Closed City begins to fracture, Semyonov seals the exits with civilians still inside.
entries.flavor_text: Mercy is a luxury containment cannot afford.

relationships.subject: Dr. Elena Morozova
relationships.dynamic: Semyonov regards Elena as both an irreplaceable state asset and a contamination risk.

relationships.subject: Major Yuri Volkov
relationships.dynamic: Yuri's feelings for Elena make him unreliable in Semyonov's system of absolute command.

entries.interpretation: Semyonov believes every disaster can be mastered through discipline, sacrifice, and a sufficiently strong door. His authority protects thousands, but each ruthless decision makes it harder to tell whether he is containing the breach or building the perfect world for it.
entries.when_drawn: Establish firm boundaries and accept the burden of leadership, but question any order that requires you to stop seeing the people trapped beneath it.

entries.affirmation: I decide which traditions deserve my obedience.
entries.narrative: Irina Karpova's key opens no ordinary lock. Presented at restricted checkpoints, it causes guards to step aside, files to become unclassified, and forbidden experiments to acquire official approval. Some claim the key predates Karpova and that she merely inherited her place within a much older order.
entries.flavor_text: Authority opens what force cannot.

relationships.subject: Irina Vasilievna Karpova
relationships.dynamic: The key makes Karpova the visible gatekeeper of a hidden institutional order that may predate her authority.

hidden_threads.clue: The key may have been inherited from an order older than the Closed City program.

entries.interpretation: The Black Key represents entry through sanctioned power. It grants access to knowledge, but demands obedience to the institution guarding it. Possessing the key may open the inner chamber while quietly closing every path back out.
entries.when_drawn: Learn from tradition, but question who controls it.

entries.affirmation: I choose with an open heart.
entries.narrative: After the synchronization, Elena's chair is empty, but her work keeps answering. Mikhail hears a mind hidden within the data. Yuri hears the woman he loves calling for rescue. Neither can prove the voice is truly hers, while Zoya may already know what waits on the other side.
entries.flavor_text: Her body was gone. Her work kept answering.

relationships.subject: Dr. Mikhail Orlov
relationships.dynamic: Mikhail interprets the signal through intellect, guilt, and the fear that he has lost Elena.

relationships.subject: Major Yuri Volkov
relationships.dynamic: Yuri hears the woman he loves and wants rescue even when containment demands suspicion.

relationships.subject: Zoya Miranova
relationships.dynamic: Zoya may know where Elena went and what now shares her voice.

hidden_threads.clue: The voice may be Elena, an altered Elena, or another presence using her emotional bonds as an invitation.

entries.interpretation: The Lovers appears where desire and choice become inseparable. Saving Elena could restore what was lost, release something wearing her voice, or reveal that she has chosen not to return.
entries.when_drawn: Choose what you love, but see it clearly.

entries.affirmation: I direct my strength toward the way forward.
entries.narrative: When the aurora descends and the village boundary begins to split, Buran refuses every command except Vera's. She climbs into his harness, knots red ribbons through her hair, and drives the great white tiger toward the breach. They do not flee the entities gathering inside the light. They charge through before those shapes can become real.
entries.flavor_text: He was never tamed. He simply chose her direction.

relationships.subject: Vera Kargina and Buran
relationships.dynamic: Their bond is based on earned trust rather than dominance; Buran accepts Vera's direction without surrendering his will.

entries.interpretation: The Chariot is not strength alone, but strength given purpose. Vera and Buran prevail because neither dominates the other; speed, instinct, and human judgment move together.
entries.when_drawn: Choose your direction and commit to it.

entries.affirmation: I master my fear without silencing my heart.
entries.narrative: Yuri was trained to contain anomalous beings and treat contaminated people as threats. Elena taught him that some presences beyond the breach may be intelligent rather than hostile, and he fell in love with both her conviction and its danger. He will refuse a direct order to kill her, then risk something worse when a captured entity begins speaking in her voice.
entries.flavor_text: Containment is mercy when the door opens both ways.

relationships.subject: Dr. Elena Morozova
relationships.dynamic: Yuri loves Elena and is drawn to her conviction that beings beyond the breach are not merely hostile.

hidden_threads.clue: Yuri will let a captured entity speak because it uses Elena's voice.

entries.interpretation: Yuri's strength lies in controlling the violence he could easily unleash. Yet love tests restraint as severely as anger: his desire to save Elena may become the very weakness the convergence needs.
entries.when_drawn: Meet fear with courage, not force.

entries.affirmation: I carry the light I need.
entries.narrative: The village's first path lantern was built around a shard of black meteor glass. Its flame reveals more than snow and stone: it shows whether a boundary remains intact, whether a trail is safe, and whether the aurora is lying. When the sky begins speaking with familiar voices, villagers trust the lantern instead.
entries.flavor_text: Not every light intends to guide you home.

hidden_threads.clue: The aurora can imitate familiar voices, but the meteor flame exposes its false guidance.

entries.interpretation: The Meteor Lantern offers no grand revelation. It casts one small circle of truth, asking its bearer to proceed alone and discover the next step before searching for the entire road.
entries.when_drawn: Be still and follow your inner light.

entries.affirmation: I move with change instead of resisting it.
entries.narrative: For seventeen seconds, architecture loses its authority. Reactor corridors open into drowned streets, northern snowfields, and chambers built before history. Nikolai discovers a service route where none should exist, while VERA-7 follows a path rejected by every map. Those who hesitate remain trapped; those who move may emerge somewhere impossible.
entries.flavor_text: The map was accurate. The building was not.

relationships.subject: Nikolai Yegorov and VERA-7
relationships.dynamic: Both trust impossible routes during the brief overlap, allowing different forms of instinct to outrun official maps.

hidden_threads.clue: The overlapping corridors reveal drowned Atlantean streets, Far North snowfields, and chambers linked across time.

entries.interpretation: The Wheel turns without asking who is ready. Disaster and opportunity arrive together, briefly rearranging every wall, rule, and possible future.
entries.when_drawn: Accept the change and seize its opening.

entries.affirmation: I face the truth and act with mercy.
entries.narrative: Marya Zima serves as a field nurse while generals measure the war in territory rather than lives. She treats wounds made by bullets and stranger injuries that seem to arrive from the future. Her hidden love for Stepan makes every triage decision personal, yet she refuses to save the familiar at the expense of the forgotten. Her field book and winter rites will eventually pass toward Nadia's bloodline.
entries.flavor_text: Mercy is not softness. It is work.

relationships.subject: Private Stepan Kuznetsov
relationships.dynamic: Marya and Stepan share a hidden love that makes every battlefield triage decision painfully personal.

relationships.subject: Nadia Belaya
relationships.dynamic: Marya's field book and winter healing rites may become part of the inheritance that reaches Nadia's Far North story decades later.

hidden_threads.clue: Some injuries Marya treats appear to have been caused by forces reaching backward from the future Closed City.

entries.interpretation: Marya embodies justice at its most human: deciding who can still be saved when time, medicine, and warmth are scarce. She knows that fairness without compassion is merely another form of cold.
entries.when_drawn: See clearly, then choose what is fair.

entries.affirmation: I release the life I can no longer return to.
entries.narrative: Pavel survives the Closed City Incident only to awaken impossibly far north, with the Sky-Hide Mirror against his chest and Nadia Belaya tending wounds that should have killed him. After Nadia disappears, he follows the Deep North Circus for Mila Vetrova, uncertain whether he is pursuing a woman, escaping his former life, or carrying the mirror somewhere it intends to go.
entries.flavor_text: I keep waking where my life should have ended.

relationships.subject: Mila Vetrova
relationships.dynamic: Pavel's attraction to Mila begins as longing for beauty and escape, but he must learn to see her as a person rather than a symbol of salvation.

relationships.subject: Nadia Belaya
relationships.dynamic: Nadia saves Pavel and leaves before he can turn gratitude into dependence or demand that she explain his survival.

hidden_threads.clue: The Sky-Hide Mirror may be carrying Pavel toward its northern purpose rather than merely traveling with him.

entries.interpretation: Pavel embodies the Hanged Man because survival has suspended him between identities. His attraction to Mila is sincere, but he must stop treating her as an escape and see her as a person with desires of her own. Only by surrendering the man he was can he understand why Nadia found him and what the mirror carried him north to witness.
entries.when_drawn: Stop forcing the answer and allow your perspective to change.

entries.affirmation: I release what has ended and follow what changes.
entries.narrative: Beyond the Winter Front, Nikolai Baranov discovers a cabin older than the war. One iron ring lies among dead candles and rotted bindings; another has turned toward the door, where the first dawn light resembles the lantern glow of a circus that will not arrive for forty years.
entries.flavor_text: The rite was over. The road it opened was not.

relationships.subject: Nikolai Baranov
relationships.dynamic: Nikolai discovers that the ritual in the cabin predates the war and recognizes that its iron rings were left for someone to carry onward.

relationships.subject: Deep North Circus
relationships.dynamic: Decades later, the circus inherits the rings and repeats a rite whose original purpose has been forgotten.

hidden_threads.clue: The rings may preserve an ancient protection, or they may continue an invitation that was never properly closed.
connects_to: The Circus Performs The Old Rite

entries.interpretation: The Cabin Rite embodies Death as a change of form. Its original practitioners are gone, yet their iron rings will leave the cabin, travel north, and become part of the Deep North Circus's Old Rite. What ended in secrecy survives as performance, though no one yet knows whether the circus inherited a protection or continued an unfinished invitation.
entries.when_drawn: Let the finished form fall away so its living purpose can continue.

entries.affirmation: I create passage by holding opposites in balance.
entries.narrative: Anya Lebedeva made a career escaping rooms officials believed were secure, combining relay timing, lock pressure, and a performer's instinct for misdirection. When Elena's dream research teaches the Closed City to answer symbols, Anya balances machinery against occult rhythm and gives Pavel seventeen seconds to escape. The passage saves him, but something beyond the city may have learned the route.
entries.flavor_text: I do not open doors. I balance exits.

relationships.subject: Pavel Sokolov
relationships.dynamic: Anya engineers the seventeen-second opening that allows Pavel to escape the Closed City with the Sky-Hide Mirror.

relationships.subject: Colonel Viktor Semyonov
relationships.dynamic: Semyonov wants Anya contained because her talent makes every lockdown imperfect.

relationships.subject: Irina Karpova
relationships.dynamic: Karpova recognizes Anya's value and may try to purchase, flatter, or coerce her into opening forbidden doors.

hidden_threads.clue: Every route Anya opens may teach something outside the Closed City how to enter.

entries.interpretation: Anya embodies Temperance through controlled passage between incompatible forces: machinery and ritual, imprisonment and freedom, one reality and another. Her precision makes Semyonov want her contained and Karpova want her controlled.
entries.when_drawn: Bring opposing forces into balance before choosing your way through.

entries.affirmation: I recognize the power that seeks to possess me.
entries.narrative: Beneath a collapsed enemy position, the soldiers uncover black notebooks, broken icons, astrological wheels, bone counters, and maps of places that do not exist. Alexei Vranov believes the cache may explain the impossible winter. Ilya Voronin feels something inside it waiting to be carried out.
entries.flavor_text: Every object offered an answer. Every answer wanted a price.

relationships.subject: Alexei Vranov
relationships.dynamic: Alexei sees the cache as evidence that could explain the impossible winter and connect the battlefield to an older world.

relationships.subject: Ilya Voronin
relationships.dynamic: Ilya senses that something within the cache wants to be carried beyond the ruined position.

hidden_threads.clue: Using the cache's relics strengthens the bond between the Winter Front, ancient Atlantis, and the future Closed City.

entries.interpretation: The cache embodies the Devil as dangerous knowledge freely accepted. Its relics promise victory, understanding, and survival, but each use strengthens the bond between the Winter Front, Atlantis, and the future Closed City.
entries.when_drawn: Name what tempts you before deciding what it is worth.

entries.affirmation: I face what remains when certainty collapses.
entries.narrative: At 02:17, the reactor pulse, orbital receiver, and Elena's dream monitors synchronize. The facility does not explode outward; it opens inward, occupying several realities for seventeen seconds. Orlov collapses, Elena disappears into the signal, Zoya awakens changed, and Major Yuri Volkov must choose between the woman he loves and the orders demanding containment.
entries.flavor_text: The alarms warned them to leave. Every door led deeper inside.

relationships.subject: Elena Morozova and Major Yuri Volkov
relationships.dynamic: Elena's disappearance forces Yuri to choose between finding the woman he loves and obeying the containment orders that may condemn her.

relationships.subject: Zoya Miranova
relationships.dynamic: The incident changes Zoya from a contained subject into something the facility can no longer explain or fully confine.

hidden_threads.clue: The incident did not create the convergence; it exposed forces already gathering beneath the city and across other eras.

entries.interpretation: The Closed City Incident is the Tower's catastrophic revelation: the facility's walls, loyalties, and scientific explanations fail at once. Nothing created the convergence that night. The disaster merely exposed what had already been gathering beneath the city.
entries.when_drawn: Let the collapse reveal what was never stable.

entries.affirmation: I trust that healing is possible.
entries.narrative: Nadia Belaya finds Pavel dying beneath an aurora where no survivor should have been able to reach. She heals him with medicine, breath, and northern rites, then leaves before gratitude can become dependence. Nadia never tells him that Aksinya's distant vision guided her to the snow, or that the relic against his chest seemed to call her by name.
entries.flavor_text: Survival is not an answer. It is another question.

relationships.subject: Pavel Sokolov
relationships.dynamic: Nadia saves Pavel but leaves before his gratitude can become dependence or an expectation that she explain his survival.

relationships.subject: Aksinya Morozova
relationships.dynamic: Aksinya's distant vision quietly guides Nadia to Pavel without directly entering the rescue.

hidden_threads.clue: The relic against Pavel's chest may have called Nadia to him by name.

entries.interpretation: Nadia embodies the Star as hope made real through compassionate action. She saves Pavel without promising him certainty, affection, or a return to his former life. Her mercy illuminates a path; it does not walk it for him.
entries.when_drawn: Accept the hope being offered without making its source perfect.

entries.affirmation: I can trust myself even when I feel uncertain.
entries.narrative: Zoya Miranova entered the Closed City as a remote-viewing subject, but the program treated her body as a receiver and her dreams as state property. After the incident, several voices speak through her, and she can no longer tell whether her attraction to Orlov is entirely her own. His sleeping mind is the one place where her fractured selves can gather.
entries.flavor_text: I woke with too many names.

relationships.subject: Dr. Mikhail Orlov
relationships.dynamic: Zoya is drawn to Orlov because his sleeping mind gives her fractured selves a place to gather, though neither knows whether the attraction belongs to them alone.

hidden_threads.clue: Some of Zoya's voices may be alternate selves, convergence entities, or people observing the Closed City from other realities.

entries.interpretation: Zoya embodies the Moon's uncertain territory between intuition and illusion. Her feelings may be genuine, manipulated, or shared by something beyond her, yet denying them gives the program continued power over her identity.
entries.when_drawn: Trust your instincts, but question what fear and desire are showing you.

entries.affirmation: I am ready to see the truth clearly.
entries.narrative: During the night shift, the reactor's warning clicks settle into a slow, repeating cadence. One worker raises his hand toward the chamber without knowing why, while golden diagrams spread across the observation glass and recording paper. Elena recognizes the pattern from her dreams: the reactor is not failing. It is praying, and something has begun to answer.
entries.flavor_text: It answered every question with light.

relationships.subject: Elena Morozova
relationships.dynamic: Elena recognizes that the reactor's luminous patterns reproduce a language she has already encountered in her dreams.

relationships.subject: Closed City workers
relationships.dynamic: The workers are the first to feel the reactor's call and the first whose bodies will bear the cost of exploiting it.

hidden_threads.clue: The reactor's patterned light behaves like an invocation, and an unknown intelligence has begun to answer it.

entries.interpretation: Reactor Prayer embodies the Sun as an overwhelming moment of clarity. The reactor reveals that the Closed City's science and Elena's dream work have been speaking the same language. This knowledge offers extraordinary power, but its light falls first upon the workers whose bodies will pay for it.
entries.when_drawn: Face what has become clear and decide how you will use it.

entries.affirmation: I am ready to answer the call.
entries.narrative: Forty years after the meteor struck the Far North, the Closed City Incident reawakens something beneath its crater. Heat splits the frozen ground, and figures appear in the aurora carrying voices and memories from the time of the impact. The village elders recognize people they lost that winter. Watching from afar, Aksinya cannot yet tell whether these are the dead returning or something using their memories to be welcomed home.
entries.flavor_text: The sky called back everyone the village had buried.

relationships.subject: Village elders
relationships.dynamic: The elders recognize lost loved ones among the aurora figures, making the awakening a deeply personal temptation to welcome them home.

relationships.subject: Aksinya Morozova
relationships.dynamic: Aksinya watches from afar, uncertain whether the figures are returning souls or beings borrowing familiar memories.

hidden_threads.clue: The aurora figures may use the village's grief to gain entry rather than truly restore the dead.

entries.interpretation: The waking meteor embodies Judgement as an unavoidable summons. The Closed City has not brought something entirely new to the Far North; it has called an older wound back into consequence. The village must now face what its survival required it to forget.
entries.when_drawn: Answer what is calling you and face what remains unfinished.

entries.affirmation: I belong, and my life has meaning.
entries.narrative: The Aal Luuk Mas Root has remained alive through generations of northern keepers, connecting the upper, middle, and lower worlds. When the Closed City convergence reawakens the meteor site, its paths begin opening again. Nadia and Aksinya understand the danger: the Root could help displaced people like Pavel find their way home, but every passage could also admit something the village cannot shelter.
entries.flavor_text: Every branch reaches outward. Every root remembers home.

relationships.subject: Nadia Belaya and Aksinya Morozova
relationships.dynamic: Both recognize the Root's potential to restore displaced people and the danger of admitting unwanted beings through its paths.

relationships.subject: Pavel Sokolov
relationships.dynamic: The Root offers Pavel a possible way home while forcing him to consider where he now belongs.

hidden_threads.clue: The convergence reopens inherited paths through the Root, allowing passage in both directions.

entries.interpretation: The Root embodies the World as the joining of what has been scattered. Pavel's arrival, the northern healing traditions, and the realities opened by the convergence meet along its living paths. His journey reaches completion when he understands what he carries and chooses where he belongs; returning to his old life may no longer mean coming home.
entries.when_drawn: Recognize how far you have come and let yourself belong.

entries.affirmation: I have the courage to begin.
entries.narrative: After Pavel arrives in the Far North carrying the Sky-Hide Mirror, the aurora opens a passage above an old ritual path. His escape from the Closed City has brought the convergence to a place already altered by the meteor forty years earlier. For the village and the circus, the opening offers a first chance to deliberately cross into the realities they have only glimpsed in dreams.
entries.flavor_text: For generations, they had rehearsed a door. Tonight, it opened.

relationships.subject: Pavel Sokolov
relationships.dynamic: Pavel's arrival with the Sky-Hide Mirror links the Closed City convergence to the Far North's older meteor wound.

hidden_threads.clue: The village and circus can now attempt intentional passage into realities previously encountered only in dreams.
connects_to: The Circus Performs The Old Rite

entries.interpretation: The Ace of Wands marks the moment possibility becomes something you can act upon. The passage offers discovery, but no promise of a safe destination. This card asks you to notice what awakens your curiosity or desire, then give it a practical beginning. You do not need the whole journey planned to take a thoughtful first step.
entries.when_drawn: Choose what excites you and take one clear step toward it.

entries.affirmation: I can choose where I go next.
entries.narrative: General Volkov's campaign map begins changing after the enemy occult cache is opened. Among familiar roads and casualty marks, new routes appear, leading beyond the territory his army was ordered to hold. Volkov sees a chance to secure more than a military victory, and begins planning advances toward places his soldiers cannot find on any other map.
entries.flavor_text: He had been ordered to hold the line. The map offered him an empire.

relationships.subject: General Arkady Volkov
relationships.dynamic: Volkov treats the map's impossible routes as an opportunity for personal conquest, leaving his soldiers to bear the cost.

hidden_threads.clue: Opening the enemy cache changes the map, offering routes outside ordinary military geography.

entries.interpretation: The Two of Wands concerns deciding what to pursue beyond familiar ground. Volkov's map gives his ambition a direction, but he leaves others to bear the cost. For the reader, this card invites a wider view: consider what you want, what the journey requires, and who your plans will affect before committing.
entries.when_drawn: Choose your direction and make a realistic plan.

entries.affirmation: I am open to possibilities beyond what I know.
entries.narrative: In 1942, a Winter Front field radio receives reactor warnings and security orders from the Closed City of 1982. Through the interference, Elena Morozova's voice reaches soldiers standing on the land where her facility will one day be built. The transmission reveals that their discoveries in the enemy occult cache have consequences extending forty years beyond the war.
entries.flavor_text: You drew this card. Did you think that meant you were only watching?

relationships.subject: Elena Morozova and the Winter Front soldiers
relationships.dynamic: Elena's transmission links the soldiers' discoveries in 1942 to the Closed City Incident forty years later.

hidden_threads.clue: This is the deck's only fourth-wall break. Elena addresses the person drawing the card; whether she warns, invites, or asks for help remains open.

entries.interpretation: The Three of Wands asks you to consider how far your choices might reach. Elena's transmission crosses forty years, but her gaze reaches beyond the soldiers to you. Whether her words are a warning, an invitation, or a request remains unclear. Consider where you have been waiting for something to happen, and whether you are ready to take part.
entries.when_drawn: What are you ready to become part of?

entries.affirmation: I deserve to feel at home.
entries.narrative: The northern village grew around an ancient crown of stone and antler, left by keepers whose names have been forgotten. Generations have gathered beside it to celebrate marriages, welcome travelers, and mark another winter survived. When the convergence unsettles the village, Vera keeps the celebration alive: sharing food, music, and warmth renews the promise that no household faces the darkness alone.
entries.flavor_text: We stayed because someone always kept a place for us.

relationships.subject: Vera Kargina and the northern village
relationships.dynamic: Vera preserves the communal celebration around the Crown as a promise of mutual care during the convergence.

entries.interpretation: The Four of Wands celebrates the security people build together. The Crown gives the village a gathering place, but its promise lives through those who show up for one another. This card invites you to recognize a milestone, welcome support, or strengthen the relationships that make a place feel like home. Joy deserves time even when life remains uncertain.
entries.when_drawn: Celebrate what you have built and the people who helped you build it.

entries.affirmation: I can stand my ground without losing myself.
entries.narrative: General Volkov orders another advance across ground the winter has made nearly impassable. Stepan Kuznetsov goes forward beside replacements whose names he learned that morning, trying to keep them together as shouted orders dissolve into gunfire. Volkov measures success in territory held; Stepan measures it in men who return.
entries.flavor_text: The order was simple. Surviving it required everyone.

relationships.subject: General Arkady Volkov and Private Stepan Kuznetsov
relationships.dynamic: Volkov's territorial ambition conflicts with Stepan's effort to keep the men beside him alive.

entries.interpretation: The Five of Wands brings competing aims into collision. Volkov's ambition and the soldiers' need to survive pull the same advance in different directions. In your own conflicts, consider whether disagreement is helping people find a better way or simply exhausting them. Stand up for what matters while looking for a purpose others can share.
entries.when_drawn: Choose which struggle deserves your energy and what you want it to achieve.

entries.affirmation: I can take pride in how far I have come.
entries.narrative: Alexei Vranov emerges from the enemy occult cache carrying a black-and-gold Atlantean standard, and the exhausted soldiers greet him as a hero. Through it, he glimpses ancient Atlantis, the northern meteor, and a city that will not exist for forty years. Marya Zima witnesses his transformation and realizes that the power they are celebrating has chosen someone to carry it onward.
entries.flavor_text: They called it victory before they saw what followed.

relationships.subject: Marya Zima
relationships.dynamic: Marya recognizes the burden of Alexei's transformation while the soldiers celebrate his emergence as a victory.

hidden_threads.clue: The Atlantean standard connects Alexei to ancient Atlantis, the meteor, and the future Closed City, turning public triumph into an obligation to carry its power onward.

entries.interpretation: The Six of Wands recognizes achievement and the confidence that comes from being seen. The soldiers' acclaim gives Alexei influence, even as Marya sees a responsibility they have overlooked. Accept recognition for what you have accomplished, while remembering that praise cannot decide your next step for you.
entries.when_drawn: Accept your success and choose how you will carry it forward.

entries.affirmation: I have the right to stand my ground.
entries.narrative: Irina Sokolova holds a snowy ridge alone against advancing shapes after the enemy occult cache awakens. Her rifle survives the encounter changed: through its sight, the ridge remains visible even when she aims elsewhere. The weapon preserves the place where she refused to yield, binding her protection of others to a moment she cannot leave behind.
entries.flavor_text: The ridge held because she did.

relationships.subject: Irina Sokolova
relationships.dynamic: The rifle preserves Irina's solitary defense of the ridge, linking her protection of others to the burden of remaining on guard.

hidden_threads.clue: After the cache awakens, the rifle's sight retains the ridge regardless of where it is aimed.

entries.interpretation: The Seven of Wands concerns defending something important under pressure. Irina's stand protects others, but the rifle also carries the cost of remaining constantly on guard. Consider which boundaries deserve your resolve and where you need support. Courage can mean holding your position without treating every approach as an attack.
entries.when_drawn: Protect what matters, and be clear about what you are defending.

entries.affirmation: I am ready to move forward.
entries.narrative: Before the Closed City Incident, the cosmonaut relay array turns without an operator's command, aiming at a patch of sky where no scheduled satellite should be. Elena suspects it has found contact beyond the realities explored in her dream research. Karpova sees the value of that contact immediately, putting pressure on the scientists to understand and use it before they know what has answered.
entries.flavor_text: The receiver moved before anyone knew where to listen.

relationships.subject: Elena Morozova and Irina Karpova
relationships.dynamic: Elena investigates the unexpected contact while Karpova presses the scientists to exploit its value before they understand its source.

hidden_threads.clue: The array points beyond scheduled satellite traffic toward an unidentified contact connected to Elena's dream research.

entries.interpretation: The array's sudden turn marks the end of waiting: contact has been made, and events begin moving quickly. In your life, this may appear as an unexpected message, a long-awaited reply, or plans suddenly gathering momentum. Like the researchers receiving the signal, you may need to respond before you understand everything. Act on what is clear, ask direct questions, and check that excitement or pressure is not rushing you into a commitment.
entries.when_drawn: Respond to what is arriving, and clarify what you need to know before committing.

entries.affirmation: I can keep going and accept support.
entries.narrative: Oleg Baranov hauls timber, raises circus poles, and carries injured villagers through storms that barely seem to chill him. Vera trusts him to hold the village boundary when others must retreat. Aksinya suspects his extraordinary endurance began with the meteor's influence before he was born, and fears what returning to its crater might awaken.
entries.flavor_text: Stand behind me. Then decide if you are afraid.

relationships.subject: Vera Kargina
relationships.dynamic: Vera trusts Oleg to hold the village boundary while others retreat.

relationships.subject: Aksinya Morozova
relationships.dynamic: Aksinya suspects Oleg's endurance comes from the meteor's influence and fears the consequences of his return to its crater.

hidden_threads.clue: The meteor may have affected Oleg before birth; returning to its crater could awaken more than his unusual endurance.

entries.interpretation: Oleg's endurance reflects the Nine of Wands: strength tested by repeated demands. You may feel worn down, wary of another setback, or close to finishing something that has taken more than expected. Draw on what experience has taught you, protect your remaining energy, and accept help. Persistence works best when you give yourself a chance to recover.
entries.when_drawn: Decide what will help you continue without wearing yourself out.

entries.affirmation: I do not have to carry everything alone.
entries.narrative: Private Stepan Kuznetsov carries extra ammunition for men who no longer live to use it, marching because stopping in the cold could kill him. General Volkov keeps sending his company forward, while Stepan's hidden love for field nurse Marya Zima gives him a reason to imagine life beyond the next order. On the ground where the Closed City will someday stand, ordinary soldiers bear the cost of ambitions they never chose.
entries.flavor_text: Every time someone falls, the rest of us carry more.

relationships.subject: General Arkady Volkov
relationships.dynamic: Volkov's repeated advances impose growing burdens on Stepan and the surviving soldiers.

relationships.subject: Marya Zima
relationships.dynamic: Stepan's hidden love for Marya gives him a reason to imagine a life beyond the war.

entries.interpretation: Stepan's load reflects the Ten of Wands: responsibility that has grown heavier than one person can reasonably carry. You may be keeping everything moving while neglecting your own needs, or holding obligations that others have quietly left with you. Consider what truly requires your effort, what can be shared, and what no longer needs to be done. Being dependable does not mean being endlessly available.
entries.when_drawn: Put down, share, or renegotiate one burden before taking on another.

entries.affirmation: I am free to discover what excites me.
entries.narrative: Mila Vetrova performs with the Deep North Circus, practicing movements passed down long before anyone called them acrobatics. As the convergence awakens the old northern crossings, her routines begin to reveal their ritual purpose. Pavel's attraction offers the possibility of a life beyond the circus, but Mila wants to discover whether its inheritance is a duty she would choose for herself.
entries.flavor_text: I know the routine. I want to know where it leads.

relationships.subject: Pavel Sokolov
relationships.dynamic: Pavel's attraction offers Mila a possible life beyond the circus, while she seeks to choose her own relationship to its inherited duty.

hidden_threads.clue: Mila's inherited routines preserve ritual movements whose purpose becomes apparent as the northern crossings awaken.
connects_to: The Circus Performs The Old Rite

entries.interpretation: Mila's curiosity about her inherited art reflects the Page of Wands' desire to explore. You may feel drawn toward a new interest, experience, or version of yourself before knowing where it will lead. Give that excitement room to develop through small experiments. You can learn by trying without deciding your entire future at once.
entries.when_drawn: Follow your curiosity and try something you have been eager to explore.

entries.affirmation: I can act boldly and with purpose.
entries.narrative: Buran, the great white tiger of the Deep North Circus, crossed into the Far North through the convergence. He recognizes paths around the meteor site that people have forgotten, and reacts to the Sky-Hide Mirror before Pavel understands what he carries. Vera's long friendship with Buran allows her to ride beside that instinct, though trust gives her no guarantee that he will follow her chosen road.
entries.flavor_text: You can ride him. That does not mean you choose the way.
entries.flavor_attribution: A saying among the circus performers

relationships.subject: Vera Kargina
relationships.dynamic: Vera rides Buran through mutual trust rather than command, accepting that his recognition of old paths may differ from her intentions.

relationships.subject: Pavel Sokolov
relationships.dynamic: Buran reacts to Pavel's Sky-Hide Mirror before Pavel understands its significance.

hidden_threads.clue: Buran's recognition of the meteor paths and mirror suggests knowledge of crossings beyond human memory.

entries.interpretation: Buran's charge into uncertain territory reflects the Knight of Wands' bold, restless energy. You may feel ready to pursue an attraction, begin an adventure, or act on an idea that has become impossible to ignore. Use that confidence to move forward, while checking that your enthusiasm can survive the effort that follows. A strong beginning needs direction and follow-through.
entries.when_drawn: Take bold action toward something you are willing to keep working for.

entries.affirmation: I trust myself to lead.
entries.narrative: Vera Kargina earned the village's trust as a hunter who followed strange tracks when others barred their doors. Now its leader, she carries a meteor-glass spear and rides Buran through a friendship neither mistakes for obedience. As the convergence draws strangers north, her visible authority sometimes clashes with Aksinya's hidden influence over the people both women protect.
entries.flavor_text: The snow keeps tracks. So do I.

relationships.subject: Buran
relationships.dynamic: Vera rides Buran through friendship and mutual trust rather than obedience.

relationships.subject: Aksinya Morozova
relationships.dynamic: Vera's public leadership sometimes clashes with Aksinya's hidden influence despite their shared desire to protect the village.

entries.interpretation: Vera's earned authority reflects the Queen of Wands' confidence and independence. You may be ready to take the lead, express yourself more openly, or trust an ability you have been keeping small. Let your enthusiasm draw people in, and give them room to contribute. You can be decisive without controlling every outcome or winning everyone's approval.
entries.when_drawn: Trust your abilities and take a visible role in something you care about.

entries.affirmation: I can turn my vision into action.
entries.narrative: Before the war, Ilya Voronin was a timber worker, known for taking the dangerous end of a job without making a speech about it. He defeats an enemy champion in single combat, giving exhausted soldiers a victory they can believe in. Stories of his survival begin borrowing from old bogatyr legends until the man and the myth become difficult to separate.
entries.flavor_text: If they follow me, I owe them more than courage.

hidden_threads.clue: Stories of Ilya's survival increasingly merge a living soldier with older bogatyr legends.

entries.interpretation: Ilya's influence reflects the King of Wands' ability to turn conviction into shared action. You may be ready to lead a project, commit to a larger ambition, or help others see what is possible. Give your ideas a clear direction and take responsibility for the people who trust you. Confidence becomes effective leadership when it creates room for others to succeed.
entries.when_drawn: Set a clear direction and take responsibility for bringing it to life.

entries.affirmation: I am open to giving and receiving care.
entries.narrative: Before the incident, Galina Reznik's night shifts meant changing sheets, carrying meals, and learning which patients needed someone to sit beside them. Afterward, the sealed ward fills with survivors whose injuries defy explanation. When she discovers that one is to be removed from care, she records them as dead and keeps them hidden among the living.
entries.flavor_text: No one dies quietly on my ward.

hidden_threads.clue: Galina falsifies a death record to protect an unnamed living survivor from removal from care.

entries.interpretation: Galina's care reflects the Ace of Cups' invitation to open your heart. You may be beginning a relationship, finding room for feelings you have held back, or discovering that kindness can change an encounter. Allow connection to develop without demanding certainty about where it will lead. Receiving care matters as much as offering it.
entries.when_drawn: Make room for an honest feeling or a simple act of care.

entries.affirmation: I am worthy of mutual love and respect.
entries.narrative: During a whiteout, Pavel finds Mila beside the circus tent's lantern glow. They share vodka from two humble metal cups and, for the first time, speak beyond the distance between performer and admirer. Their attraction is mutual, but the Sky-Hide Mirror stirs between them, leaving open how much of their meeting belongs to chance.
entries.flavor_text: For a moment, neither asked where the other would go tomorrow.

relationships.subject: Pavel Sokolov and Mila Vetrova
relationships.dynamic: Their first meaningful exchange turns distant admiration into mutual attraction and the possibility of a relationship.

hidden_threads.clue: The Sky-Hide Mirror responds during Pavel and Mila's encounter, raising uncertainty about the forces shaping their meeting.

entries.interpretation: Pavel and Mila's shared moment reflects the Two of Cups' promise of mutual connection. You may be finding affection, repairing trust, or entering a partnership where both people feel seen. Notice whether interest, honesty, and effort flow in both directions. Attraction opens a possibility; listening and reciprocity help it become a relationship.
entries.when_drawn: Meet someone with honesty and notice how they meet you in return.

entries.mythcards_name: The Circus Performs The Old Rite
entries.affirmation: I make room for friendship and joy.
entries.narrative: As the circus performs, acrobatics, knife throws, and music fall into an unusually precise rhythm. The crowd joins in, clapping and passing cups while the lanterns burn steadily despite the wind outside. Beneath the applause, a few older villagers recognize a pattern they remember from somewhere other than a circus.
entries.flavor_text: They remembered the celebration long after they forgot what it protected.

hidden_threads.clue: The communal performance preserves an old Atlantean convergence-stabilizing rite, hinted at through familiar patterns and steady lanterns rather than explained to the reader.

entries.interpretation: The circus's shared celebration reflects the Three of Cups' friendship and mutual support. You may have something worth celebrating, need time with people who understand you, or find encouragement through a group. Make room for connection without needing a grand occasion. Notice who helps you feel included, and offer that welcome in return.
entries.when_drawn: Reach out to people who lift your spirits and share something good.

entries.affirmation: I give myself time to know what I need.
entries.narrative: The village radios begin speaking in the voices of people lost during the meteor winter of 1942. One woman recognizes her husband when he uses a private name she has not heard in forty years. Pavel asks why she would switch it off instead of listening. "Because I want it to be him," she says, covering the receiver. "That is why someone else must decide."
entries.flavor_text: No one touched the dial. Everyone heard the invitation.

relationships.subject: Pavel Sokolov and the northern villagers
relationships.dynamic: Pavel questions a widow's refusal to listen; she recognizes that her longing for her husband could compromise her judgment.

hidden_threads.clue: The signal uses the voices of people lost in 1942 and private names, but whether the speakers are truly the dead remains unknown.

entries.interpretation: The village's refusal reflects the Four of Cups' pause before accepting what is offered. You may need distance from distractions to recognize what you actually want, or feel too disappointed or tired to notice a worthwhile connection. Give yourself time to reflect, then consider whether your withdrawal is restoring you or keeping you stuck. An offer deserves attention without requiring acceptance.
entries.when_drawn: Pause and ask whether you need rest, a different opportunity, or a more open mind.

entries.affirmation: I can grieve and still accept care.
entries.narrative: Marya Zima carries a battered metal cup through the Winter Front, using it to offer water, wash wounds, and warm spirits before another night of casualties. It grows warm in her hands when a patient can still be saved. After a failed rescue, that small warmth draws her toward someone still breathing, even while she struggles to release the hand of the person she lost.
entries.flavor_text: It never warmed for everyone. She kept carrying it.

relationships.subject: Marya Zima and her patients
relationships.dynamic: The cup calls Marya toward lives she can still save while she grieves those she could not.

entries.interpretation: Marya's cup reflects the Five of Cups' grief for what could not be saved. You may be mourning a loss, regretting a choice, or finding it difficult to see beyond disappointment. Give that sorrow its place without letting it erase the care and possibilities still available. Accepting something good does not diminish what you have lost.
entries.when_drawn: Honor what you have lost, and notice what can still support you.

entries.affirmation: I welcome the good I can carry forward.
entries.narrative: The circus reaches the village with patched wagons, lanterns, and music the older residents remember from childhood. Children run to meet performers whose families have traveled this route for generations. Watching Mila step down into the snow, Pavel feels his first anticipation since leaving the Closed City, while an elder quietly notices that one familiar act has survived without changing at all.
entries.flavor_text: The children heard new music. Their grandparents knew the words.

relationships.subject: Pavel Sokolov and Mila Vetrova
relationships.dynamic: Seeing Mila arrive with the circus awakens Pavel's anticipation after the trauma of leaving the Closed City.

hidden_threads.clue: An elder notices an act preserved unchanged across generations, hinting at the circus's inherited ritual purpose.
connects_to: The Circus Performs The Old Rite

entries.interpretation: The circus's return reflects the Six of Cups' warmth of memory and familiar kindness. You may reconnect with an old friend, revisit something you once loved, or recognize a need for simpler pleasures. Let the past remind you of what nourishes you, while allowing people and circumstances to have changed. A good memory can enrich the present without becoming a place to hide.
entries.when_drawn: Bring a remembered kindness or simple pleasure into your life today.

entries.affirmation: I can choose what is right for me.
entries.narrative: Ilya Voronin carries the heavy case out of the enemy cache, its contents untouched by the smoke. Inside, seven vessels cradle seven Atlantean rings, each engraved with a different route or oath. Studying them offers glimpses of places beyond the frozen front, but nothing in the case explains what accepting one of those promises will require.
entries.flavor_text: Seven promises. Not one account of the cost.

relationships.subject: Ilya Voronin
relationships.dynamic: Ilya recovers the case from the enemy cache, carrying its tempting and unexplained possibilities beyond the battlefield.

hidden_threads.clue: Each Atlantean ring offers a route or oath without disclosing the price of accepting it.

entries.interpretation: The case's tempting possibilities reflect the Seven of Cups' abundance of choices and uncertain promises. You may be imagining several futures, struggling to commit, or drawn to an option because of how it makes you feel. Explore what appeals to you, then look for evidence of what each choice actually involves. A vivid possibility becomes useful when you can connect it to a realistic next step.
entries.when_drawn: Choose one possibility to investigate beyond its promise.
